name: WhatsApp Cloud API client (messages, media, groups)
description:
## Context
All WhatsApp I/O goes through one thin client so that API versions, retries and error shapes are handled in a single place. Reference doc: https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/groups (Groups API). NOTE: that page could not be fetched while planning this board — confirm the exact group endpoints, payloads and enabled API version against the live docs before coding, and keep every group call behind its own small method so a version change stays local.

## Objective
`codx/junior/channels/whatsapp/client.py`: a typed client over graph.facebook.com.

## Steps
1. `WhatsAppClient(settings)`:
   - base `https://graph.facebook.com/{api_version}/{phone_number_id}`, `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, `Content-Type: application/json`.
   - `send_text(to, body, recipient_type="individual"|"group", preview_url=False)` — used both for DMs and groups.
   - `send_media(to, media_id|link, kind=image|document|audio|video, caption=None, recipient_type=...)`.
   - `upload_media(file_path)` / `get_media_metadata(media_id)` / `download_media(media_id, dest_path)`.
   - `mark_as_read(message_id)`.
2. Groups API methods (names fixed, endpoints verified at implementation): `create_group(subject, participant_wa_ids)`, `get_group(group_id)`, `update_group(group_id, subject)`, `add_participants(group_id, wa_ids)`, `remove_participants(group_id, wa_ids)`, `reset_invite_link(group_id)`, `list_join_requests(group_id)`, `approve_join_requests(group_id, wa_ids)`.
3. Errors: `WhatsAppAPIError(status_code, error_code, message, payload)`; retry with exponential backoff on 429/5xx (max 3); never log the token or the app secret.
4. New `tests/channels/test_whatsapp_client.py` with mocked HTTP: URL/method/body assertions, error mapping, retry behaviour.

## Files
- codx/junior/channels/whatsapp/__init__.py (new)
- codx/junior/channels/whatsapp/client.py (new)
- tests/channels/test_whatsapp_client.py (new)

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Text and media can be sent to a group and to a 1:1 recipient.
- [ ] Media upload/download works (media id round-trip).
- [ ] Group create/participants/invite/join-request methods exist and are unit tested against mocked responses.
- [ ] 429/5xx retried; 4xx raised as `WhatsAppAPIError` with the Meta error code preserved.
- [ ] No secret appears in any log line.
